Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.agent

Class McpAgentRunner

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.agent.McpAgentRunner
public final class McpAgentRunner extends Object
The "agent testing" endgame: hands an MCP server's tools to Claude and runs the full tool-calling loop. Each turn the model may emit tool_use blocks; the runner executes them via the supplied McpAgentRunner.ToolExecutor (wired to McpClient.callTool), feeds the results back as tool_result blocks, and repeats until the model answers without calling a tool (or a turn cap is hit). Thinking and tool_use blocks are preserved verbatim between turns because each assistant Message is appended whole.

The toAnthropicTool(com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.mcp.McpTypes.Tool) conversion is pure (no network) and is the unit-tested seam; the full run(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.List<com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.mcp.McpTypes.Tool>, com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.agent.McpAgentRunner.ToolExecutor, com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.agent.McpAgentRunner.Listener) needs a live ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and an MCP server, so the UI drives it on a background thread.
